summary.text: Bruce Borders is a Republican member of the Indiana House representing District 45, which includes Greene and Sullivan counties and portions of Daviess, Knox and Vigo counties.
The caucus page says he has served from 2004 to 2012 and from 2014 to the present.

paragraphs.text: Borders was born and raised in the Wabash Valley and was valedictorian of his class at Shakamak High School.
The page says he holds a bachelor's degree in business administration from Evangel University and owns Borders Insurance & Financial Services.
The page lists Borders as vice chair of the Local Government Committee.
It says he lives with his wife, Lola, has three children and five grandchildren, and is known for an Elvis Presley impersonation featured on national television programs.
